title: [Feature Request] Show current model below prompt area
body: Given that it makes a difference which model is currently active, I would like to see it below the prompt input area at all times.
author: Heilemann

top_comments.author: adawalli
top_comments.body: Thanks for raising this @Heilemann - I was about to submit the same issue. Becoming a "program manager" of our junior devs (claude code) increases the importance as the "manager" knowing which model is currently in use.

top_comments.author: adawalli
top_comments.body:
This feature is crucial for effective usage management. With the automatic model switching between Opus 4 and Sonnet 4, users need visibility into which model is actively processing their requests.

The current system switches models based on usage limits (Opus 4 for up to 20% of usage, then Sonnet 4), but without a clear indicator, users cannot:
- Understand why response quality/speed might suddenly change
- Make informed decisions about task complexity based on the current model
- Track their

top_comments.author: rcdailey
top_comments.body:
It is very important for this to be just one small piece of a more model-oriented workflow. Ultimately we need the ability to do more:

- Assign default models for Plan vs non-plan modes
- The ability to switch models without rejecting a plan in Plan Mode
- A convenient shortcut key to cycle or toggle between sonnet and opus (may address the previous point as well).
